intro: Lesson 34: The mean and spotting anomalies. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: Circle any anomaly and leave it out of the mean. Round to 1 decimal place.

blocks.answers: Flat sheet: 2.3; Zigzag: 19; Tube: 11.5 (25 is an anomaly); Folded edges: 7; Two sheets flat: 4.5 (12 is an anomaly)

points: Leave it out of the mean, and say so

parts.text: 30 is far from the others: an anomaly

questions.q: Find the mean of 20, 22 and 24 cm.
Core: Work out the means for the bridge results table on the sheet. Circle any anomalies and leave them out.
questions.a: Correct means; anomalies circled (as on the answer sheet)

questions.q: Extend: Work out the mean of your own bridge repeats from last week.

questions.a: Odd results have less effect; it is closer to the true value
